subject.title: Feature: enrich usage/status JSON with agent, cron, and channel labels

question: Should OpenClaw add a stable privacy-safe attribution contract to status/usage JSON now, and which fields should be canonical across status JSON and sessions.usage?
rationale: This would extend public CLI/Gateway JSON output and touches channel target privacy, cron identity, and overlap with a narrower CLI/TUI display issue, so automation should not pick the contract unilaterally.

options.title: Add additive core attribution
options.body: Add optional fields such as sessionKind, cronJobId/name, privacy-safe channel target kind, and runtime to the shared status/usage row contracts, with tests and docs.

options.title: Defer to display-only work
options.body: Keep this issue open as product input and solve only the narrower CLI/TUI label request in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51184 first.

options.title: Decline new JSON contract
options.body: Document the current supported joins and leave richer dashboard attribution to external adapters until a stronger user need appears.

recommendation.title: Add additive core attribution
recommendation.body: Add optional fields such as sessionKind, cronJobId/name, privacy-safe channel target kind, and runtime to the shared status/usage row contracts, with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The current status/usage row contracts and adjacent cron diagnostic helper are attributed to this recent history.
